title: Gloss Highlighter
descriptionHtml:
✓ High Shine Finish✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Cream Formula✓ Without Parabens✓ Long-wearing
What it is: A nonstick universal formula that can be used on top of makeup or as a primer base, giving you the perfect glass-like glow.

Coverage: Light

Finish: Radiant

Formulation: Liquid

Highlighted Ingredients:
- VITAOILS PLUS: Deeply nourishes and visibly smooths the epidermis.
- dl-α-Tocopheryl Acetate: Antioxidant vitamin E.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens. It is also vegan, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging.

What Else You Need to Know: REFY's Gloss Highlighter can be used on cheekbones, eyelids, and under brows, or on the cupid's bow, lips, and collarbones.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-For best results, use on top of REFY Cream Bronzer and Cream Blush (both sold separately).
-Squeeze a very small amount of product onto the tip of the finger and gently tap onto high points of the face.
-Blend in by pressing into target areas.
-The nonsticky formula will set into the skin, leaving a radiant-looking glow on top of the skin.
-Can be used on cheekbones, eyelids, under brow, Cupid's bow, lips, and collarbones.
Ingredients+
-VITAOILS PLUS: Deeply nourishes and visibly smooths the epidermis.
-dl-α-Tocopheryl Acetate: Antioxidant vitamin E.

Hydrogenated Polydecene, Propylene Glycol Dibenzoate, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Paraffinum Liquidum, Isohexadecane, Styrene-Ethylene/Propylene-(Styrene), Synthetic Wax, Sorbitan Sesquioleate, Cetyl PEG/PPG-10/1 Dimethicone, Phenoxyethanol, Fragrance (Parfum), Pentaerythrityl Tetra-di-t-butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Tocopheryl Acetate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Linum Usitatissimum (Linseed) Seed Oil, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Macadamia Ternifolia Seed Oil, Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract.
May Contain: Mica, Titanium Dioxide, Iron Oxides – Red, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite.
